name: solana_backend_status
description: Read the Solana PAPER portfolio, open positions, pending decision and circuit breakers from GET /v1/status.

name: solana_backend_command
description: Call POST /v1/commands on the configured authenticated Solana PAPER backend. The backend validates command arguments. Never executes arbitrary shell commands or signs a transaction. Supply a unique idempotency key per logical request; reuse the same key when retrying.

args.description: Arguments exactly matching GET /v1/contract; use empty object for commands with no arguments.
